scope: JavaScript modules reached by the E2-C product page's import graph, plus every *.js in editor-shell-v2, editor-shell, input, sdk, reader-shell
algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 path + NUL + lowercase file SHA-256 + LF for each included path in lexicographic order

excluded.reason: Host-side decision module; the E2-C product page renders its own notice element and never imports it. Covered by editor-shell/tests/recovery-notice.test.mjs. Including it would bind browser evidence to code the E2-C matrix does not execute.

Bound separately and more precisely as workerSha256: the copy that actually runs is the one inside dist/profiles/e2-editor-v2, not this source file. Binding both would make one legitimate worker change break the shell bundle for a reason the shell bundle is not about.
The R6 reader shell. Not in the editor page's import graph; only reader-shell/tile-scheduler.js is.
The reader shell's own state machine, not the editor's (editor-shell/state-machine.js is the one bound here). Not in the editor page's import graph.
